status: Static reverse engineering; not a complete executable port. Names below are inferred semantic labels, not original source symbols.

architecture.palette_animation: ovl_13.c FUN_ovl_13__0254f6; species-specific palette handling also exists

resources.dialog_format: u16 recordCount; recordCount records of 11 signed 16-bit words; u16 textBytes; NUL-separated CP437 strings; final extra file byte

dialog_record.words_0_through_5: Up to six main choice text offsets; -1 marks unused slots
dialog_record.word_6: First extra choice text offset, usually LEAVE
dialog_record.word_7: Second extra choice text offset, usually FIGHT
dialog_record.word_10: Extra-choice availability/count control. Usually 0, 1, or 2; CICIS1 record 13 contains 3, retained raw and requires investigation.

resources.dynamic_text: Speech can contain printf-style substitutions. Script arguments supply values; raw extracted text retains placeholders.
resources.visual_format: PANI version 4, compressed indexed sprites, palette blocks, viewport metadata, sprite table, stack-based animation bytecode
resources.visual_extraction_limit: Individual sprites and bytecode recovered. Animation composition and playback not implemented. X1 four-bit sprite nibble order inferred from packed format; not compared against runtime capture.

verified_examples.effect: ovl_22 FUN_029428 selects state 18; FUN_0294d4 sets DAT_2a22_e453=1 (Acari treaty) and displays record 17
State 12 displays record 11, then clears current world's race/ownership and updates world flags; dialog ends
State 9 sets DAT_2a22_e3c2=1 (Cicisbeo treaty) and displays record 8
State 14 compares selected species to Halicot/Monad, records disclosure flags, and reduces Cicisbeo attitude by 4 for the Halicot disclosure
Entry computes which rival alliances still have worlds; treaty/trade branches change based on these flags in addition to attitude
